number.why: HR 0.49 (0.31-0.79) is EINSTEIN-PE major bleeding, rivaroxaban vs enoxaparin/VKA. It is not the principal safety composite (major or CRNM, HR 0.90) in the preceding sentence.

quotes.span: Major bleeding was observed in 26 patients (1.1%) in the rivaroxaban group and 52 patients (2.2%) in the standard-therapy group (hazard ratio, 0.49; 95% CI, 0.31 to 0.79; P=0.003).
The principal safety outcome occurred in 10.3% of patients in the rivaroxaban group and 11.4% of those in the standard-therapy group (hazard ratio, 0.90; 95% CI, 0.76 to 1.07; P=0.23).

entry.why: Acute symptomatic PE (with or without DVT) is a subset of acute symptomatic VTE; minimum age 18; comparator is a VKA after enoxaparin.

quotes.span: Confirmed acute symptomatic proximal PE with or without symptomatic DVT

missed: The registry's only 'Major bleeding' measurement is an ITT efficacy-component percentage (1.4 vs 2.4) that differs from the abstract (1.1% vs 2.2%). Anyone pooling counts rather than the HR must not mix the two. The trial is open-label; the question does not require blinding.
